slides.headline: TERENCE TAO SAID AI IS MOVING AT AN INSANE PACE WITH NO REASON
slides.kicker: THE GREATEST MATHEMATICIAN ALIVE IS WORRIED
slides.image_prompt: a lone silhouette from behind with arms spread wide stopping a speeding train covered in AI logos, with the X logo in a big circle

caption:
Terence Tao said AI is moving dangerously fast. There is no reason for it, he said. Nobody understands where this ends.

Terence Tao is widely considered the greatest living mathematician. Fields Medal winner. When he says something is dangerous, you would think people would listen.

On September 19, his words landed on X: AI is moving at an "insane" pace with "no reason at all" to be this fast. He had described it as "extremely nonlinear dynamics," meaning nobody actually knows how this ends when you are rewriting civilization this quickly.

Then @Dr_Singularity showed up. His argument: AI needs to move fast to cure cancer and save millions. His verdict on Tao: "you clearly care more about your ego than the greater good for all humanity." The person who typed it literally named himself after the idea that AI will one day surpass all human intelligence. He accused the world's greatest mathematician of letting ego override reason.

Dr Singularity also said the world "looks almost the same as it did in 2010." If you believe that, no expert warning will ever land. The people funding and building AI now have a script to dismiss anyone who says slow down. They just used it on the greatest living mathematician. That speed is shaping your job and your money right now.

When the response to "we don't understand the risks" becomes "you just want people to die of cancer," the argument is over. That is not a social media fight. That is the environment your decisions are being made in.

Running a business? DM us "AI" and we will show you what this means for yours.

Sources: Dr_Singularity on X, haider1 on X
